title: JobRecord
description: One logical job submission. Retries add attempts; each attempt has its own run.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

command.description: argv, run from `cwd` inside the project checkout.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the checkout.

environment.description: `uv`: run through `uv run --frozen --project <checkout>` (the project's own environment). `none`: run argv as given.

env.description: Extra environment variables. Stored in plain text: never put secrets here.

limits.title: JobLimits
limits.description: CPU, memory, time and task limits for one attempt.

artifact_paths.description: Globs relative to the checkout, collected as artifacts after the process exits (for scripts without the SDK).

metrics_file.description: File adapter for scripts without the SDK: a JSON-lines file (relative to the checkout) the collector tails; each object's numeric fields (nested ones flattened with `/`) become metrics at its step.

metrics_format.title: MetricsFormat
metrics_format.description: How the metrics-file adapter reads each line: nested objects are always flattened with `/`; these name the step and time keys, which are never metrics.

step_keys.description: Keys that hold the step, the first holding a non-negative integer wins; nested keys by their flattened name (`validation/global_step`). Default `["step"]`; without one, the line number.

timestamp_key.description: Key that holds the time: milliseconds, or seconds when below 1e11. Default `timestamp`; without one, the read time.

input_paths.description: Globs relative to the checkout, recorded as `inputs/<path>` artifacts as the job starts (configs the source commit does not hold, e.g. ignored ones). Jobs on this machine only.

description.description: What the run tests and why, in a sentence or two. Each attempt's run starts with it as its summary (ADR 0048).

study_id.title: StudyId
study_id.description: Study identifier (a planned comparison: baseline plus variants).

variant_id.title: VariantId
variant_id.description: Variant identifier (one configuration or code change under test).

task_id.title: TaskId
task_id.description: AblationKit task identifier (UI- or agent-first task).

agenda_item.description: The item of the researcher's agenda this job serves (ADR 0058): `note:<id>` or `L<n>`.

mlproject.title: MlprojectRunInfo
mlproject.description: The `MLproject` entrypoint a job was launched from (spec §5.5 MLflow Projects). It runs with local environment semantics in the job runner.

target_id.title: TargetId
target_id.description: Remote compute target (ADR 0023). Absent: this machine. Each attempt runs from its own staged bundle.

bundle_inputs.description: Remote jobs: coordinator-staged directories copied into each attempt's bundle at `inputs/<name>` and checksummed with it (a remote evaluation's pinned model). The job finds them under `$ABLATIONKIT_BUNDLE_INPUTS`.

compute_weight_hundredths.description: Agent jobs (ADR 0037): the weight of the job's target when it was submitted, in hundredths. Every attempt's wall time times this weight counts against the project's `compute.limit_hours`; changing the target's weight later does not change it.

via_extension.description: Submitted through this extension backend's broker (`compute.remote`, ADR 0024); only it may read or cancel the job there.

container.title: JobContainer
container.description: Set on jobs a contained agent session submits (ADR 0061): each local attempt runs in a job container of its own.

session_id.title: ContainerSessionId
session_id.description: The contained session that submitted the job.

evaluation.description: A protected evaluation's name: its pinned command ran, not the agent's.

build_environment.description: An environment build (ADR 0066): `uv sync` into a new copy of the project's environment, with the environment allowlist and no GPU. On success the copy becomes the environment the project's jobs run in.

placement.title: JobPlacement
placement.description: An agent's job is placed by AblationKit, never by the agent (ADR 0068): queued until a target in the project's pool (this machine if the policy allows local jobs, then the remote targets it allows) has a free slot, then started there.

queued_at.title: Timestamp
queued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

placed_at.title: Timestamp
placed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

target.description: Where AblationKit placed it: `local` (this machine) or a compute target's ID.

local_only.description: It runs only on this machine: a protected evaluation or an environment build (ADR 0066).

waiting.description: While queued: what it is waiting for.

error.description: Why it could not be started once placed (the job then failed).

gpu.description: The job asked for no GPU (ADR 0066). In a job container it gets no GPU device; on this machine outside one, `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` is empty (advisory).

state.title: JobState
state.description: State of the latest attempt, or `queued` before the first.

items.title: AttemptId
items.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
